'''Ketal''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Ketal system/Legends|Ketal system]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] Territories.

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an unique ID number on a particular [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] shipment allowed the [[Xucphra Corporation|Xucphra bacta-harvesting corporation]] to uncover a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Rebel base (Ketal)|base]] on Ketal. Xucphra promptly informed the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], who [[Battle of Ketal|eliminated]] the base.
